objective: Aplicar exclusivamente en EDARSAHUB Desarrollo la migracion 002 del modulo Sincronizacion Historica para extender el ledger canonico Sync_Control_Ejecuciones con parent/atomic jobs, contexto, checkpoints, retries, safe stop y dispatch Worker. No tocar Produccion ni sync_comercial_abiertas_v2.

queries.name: sync_historical_planner_preflight
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones','U') AS ledger_id, OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Tipos','U') AS systems_id, OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Capacidades','U') AS capabilities_id, OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_VersionesSistemas','U') AS versions_id, OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Sucursales','U') AS branches_id, 1/CASE WHEN DB_NAME()='EDARSAHUB' AND OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones','U') IS NOT NULL AND OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Tipos','U') IS NOT NULL AND OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Capacidades','U') IS NOT NULL AND OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_VersionesSistemas','U') IS NOT NULL AND OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Sucursales','U') IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS preflight_assertion

queries.name: sync_historical_planner_post_columns
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS required_columns, 1/CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=22 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS required_columns_assertion FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones') AND name IN ('ParentSyncControlID','RunKind','CorrelationID','SistemaTipoID','SistemaCapacidadID','SistemaVersionID','SucursalID','SucursalOrigenID','CategoriaCodigo','EntidadCodigo','BlockOrdinal','ExecutionOrder','PlanJSON','CheckpointJSON','AttemptCount','MaxAttempts','NextRetryAtUTC','PauseRequested','CancelRequested','LastHeartbeatUTC','DispatchCount','WorkerJobID')

queries.name: sync_historical_planner_post_audit_columns
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS audit_columns, 1/CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS audit_columns_assertion FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones') AND name IN ('RequestedBy','Reason','UpdatedAtUTC')

queries.name: sync_historical_planner_post_contracts
queries.sql: SELECT 1/CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.foreign_keys WHERE name IN ('FK_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_Parent','FK_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_SistemaTipo','FK_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_SistemaCapacidad','FK_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_SistemaVersion','FK_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_Sucursal'))=5 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.check_constraints WHERE name IN ('CK_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_RunKind','CK_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_PlanJSON','CK_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_CheckpointJSON','CK_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_Attempts'))=4 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sync_Control_Ejecuciones') AND name IN ('IX_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_Parent_Status','IX_Sync_Control_Ejecuciones_Correlation'))=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS planner_contract_assertion
